HAMDEN BOARD OF EDUCATION 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING 
AGENDA 
 
When: October 13, 2026 
Public Session: 6:00 PM Eastern Time 
Location: 60 Putnam Ave. Hamden, CT 06517 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar:  
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/88419296773?pwd=yABc2CGPF4fRuANi7KuOkXvZIlR0cb.1  
Passcode: 303678 
  
Telephone: +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325 , +1 312 626 6799  
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the 
beginning of the meeting. There will be time set aside for public input during this meeting. We ask that public 
comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. You may also submit your comment in writing. 
Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's subject stating the meeting's 
name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public comments will be accepted up 
to 1pm the day of the meeting. Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message. 
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters). 
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would 
extend beyond the time allotted for public comment. 
 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
 
2. Public Comment 
 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
 
4. Information Items: 
 
a. Review & update of 2026-2027 Budget 
b. Update of special education cost increases 
c. Update on audits 
 
5. Adjourn
